state:
Goal `tools-config`. Three of the configuration chapter's features have all their proofs:
`tools:config/app-per-application-blocks`, `tools:config/auditing-a-tree` and `tools:config/capabilities`.
A tool feature owes one example, one attack and one test (Rust with a `covers:` marker counts);
`bun nv proofs --id '<feature>'` says so, and adds `help` when its reference section shows no code.
A feature whose example needs settings puts its own `nvs.toml` in the feature directory
(`docs/examples/README.md` § *A grant the examples need*). A path-scoped grant in it is relative to
that file (`crate::capability::anchor`, run from `resolve`); a `[storage.*] root` is not yet.
Nothing is blocked.
